newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower, except December.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower, except December.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mostly lower on Wednesday, as position squaring for the spot July contract pushed down other months, traders said.

Prices were 0.2 to 1.4 yen lower, and the exception was the benchmark December which closed up 0.3 yen at 114.3 yen per kg. "Investors continued to liquidate long positions at the spot month throughout the day. I expect the bearish mood to remain until this Friday," a brokerage house trader said.
The July expires on July 25. As of July 22. The spot contract had 3,974 lots of open interests.
